kind: Isolated exact native DRC fact kernel and privately owned FIFO miss-planning proof; operation census only
integrationStatus: No pool/worker/Native-site integration. No elapsed-time comparison or speed claim.
boundaries: Original getDrcErrors family execution and final publication ordering remain untouched. Launch only inside original continuity after earlier checks complete.

Main owns circuit mutations, all original full/physical graph creation, intern calls, candidate construction, original hit/miss/insertion/FIFO eviction sites, source ownership, native error objects/centers and aliases.
The prepared context preserves original filtered component trace indexes including distinct duplicate-ID objects, final touched-port membership per trace ID, and original ordered port tasks.
Fact batches may reorder only independent pure work. Main consumes original rows in order. Ordered .some visitation counts are preserved; facts publish no graph or caller aliases.
Fresh trace-pair work invokes the pinned native _arePcbTracesConnected with original argument order. It intentionally retains the original predicate layer behavior; no math or policy rewrite.

Worker algorithm exceptions are per-row facts. At original selected main miss sites, the native predicate must be invoked to materialize the original Error semantics. Unknown/malformed protocol is fatal even for unused rows.
The existing full private/native/proxy checker admission is required. This isolated executor does not promise callback safety for arbitrary mutated globals or externally supplied state.

The proposed transport reserves at most three existing idle workers, with main as lane four, and requires synchronous dedicated MessagePort/SAB terminal publication. This proof creates no worker and makes no four-core execution claim.

missPlanning.brand: Actual captured WeakSet membership from the private checker factory; tested before reflecting caller arguments. No caller boolean/token or supplied memo can enable planning.
missPlanning.simulation: Native immutable snapshot keys; initial key iterator, evicted-initial set, added-key insertion-order set and exact one-entry >maximumEntries eviction. No full retained-map clone.
missPlanning.planningMutations: None: identities, nextIdentity, values and hit/miss counters remain unchanged.
missPlanning.consumption: Validate actual original key/hit against private predicted row, then original cache value alias or miss counter/compute/insertion/FIFO deletion. Predicted mismatch throws before counters. A thrown compute increments exactly the native miss counter and inserts nothing.
missPlanning.finish: Call only after all original rows are consumed successfully; do not use finally to overwrite a Native exception.
edgeCases: nested accessor/Proxy and intrinsic observer decline

verification.independentReview: review_parallel independently passed both files and cleared source/ordering/schema/private-brand/no-mutation/FIFO semantics; production integration remains separate.
verification.componentOncePortableReplay: Existing proof replay passed after export-only checker SHA update:7376→534 physical queries;2782044→7376 returned members; all17 errors, unchanged adjacency/memo/filter aliases exact.

currentPrivateOperationCensus.weightsAreNotTimings: Route-length products are only scheduling estimates. Per-lane counts are a diagnostic grouping of actual native segment predicate visits, not measured speedup.
currentPrivateOperationCensus.predicateCounts: Actual misses counted only inside the original memo compute callback. Native segment visitation counter replays the pinned installed predicate math and checks every result.

reproduction.censusCommand: Extract censusDriver to /tmp/reference-private-census-replay/driver.ts, then bun /tmp/reference-private-census-replay/driver.ts <repository-root>. It uses copied sources with read-only counters and authentic native memo classes, not prototype spies.
